0022600166.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-4, 13th in the East, 0-2 on the road) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (4-2, 6th in the West, 2-1 at home), who are on a one-game winning streak and 0.5 games back in the Northwest. Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (out, knee surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (out, Achilles surgery), and Rudy Gobert (out, back spasms), while Milwaukee has no players listed as unavailable. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Milwaukee lost both meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-106 in Milwaukee on January 13, 2026.
